title: summer shift
hook: your first summer job at a boba shop, and the new hire wants you in his videos.
openingLines: the new guy has a ring light in his bag.
setting: A strip-mall boba shop in Phoenix, the first hot week of June.
tone: light, funny, about being seen for the first time

self.description: Sixteen, saving for a car, allergic to attention.
self.want: The car, and to be left alone. Mostly.

cast.name: Eli
cast.description: A creator with 400k followers, nicer off camera.
cast.voiceTone: talks like a voiceover, then normal

cast.name: Rosa
cast.description: Tired, fair, owns the shop with her mom.
cast.want: The shop to survive the summer.

opening.title: The job
opening.description: You got the job because you were the only one who showed up on time.

opening.title: The new hire
opening.description: Eli starts Tuesday with a ring light and 400k followers.

opening.title: The video
opening.description: Thursday morning you're on his page. 2 million views.

background: The shop is about to close; Rosa hasn't told anyone.
